about: The data strapi-php's export of transfer/link-order-export.tar.gz holds: run on an empty strapi-php project (with the fixture's types), then `php bin/strapi export --no-encrypt -f link-order-export`. Links whose list order is not their id order, from both sides: a set given out of order and a connect placed before a linked genre (Book.genres), and an older book linked to an author last (Author.books, Book.author's other side).
